portfolio_role.summary: Provide the shared procedural and machine-readable coordination layer that lets self-contained repositories report their exact roles, evidence boundaries, status, and unresolved work into one deterministic cross-repository plan without centralizing their canon.
portfolio_role.upstream_contract: Each repository owns the report claims it emits and pins the exact source commit being described.
portfolio_role.downstream_contract: skill-lib validates and projects reports, preserves non-transfer boundaries, and emits deterministic identities that agents can consume without reconstructing repo state from memory.
